title: Core Formatting & Layout Conventions
source: Defence Forces Service Writing Manual 2024 (JP-04), Chapter 2
notes: Universal conventions that apply to all Service writing regardless of document type.

rules.title: Font type must be Times New Roman or Arial
rules.description: All Service writing must use a proportionally spaced font: Times New Roman or Arial.

check.where: Every run of text in the document body.

autofix.description: Set the document default font to Times New Roman and reapply to all body text.

rules.title: Body text must be 12 point
rules.description: The preferred size for general text is 12 point.

autofix.description: Set selected body text to 12 pt.

rules.title: Table text must be 10 point
rules.description: Text within tables uses 10 point.

rules.title: Footnote text must be 8 point
rules.description: Footnotes are set in 8 point.

rules.title: Text must be fully justified
rules.description: Body text is fully justified (both left and right margins aligned).

autofix.description: Apply full justification to the document body.

rules.title: Headings must be bold
rules.description: Bold type is used in all headings of the document and for column headings in tables.

check.where: Subject, main, group and paragraph headings.

rules.title: Table column headings must be bold
rules.description: Column headings in tables are bold.

check.where: The header row of each table.

rules.title: Protective markings and flags must be bold
rules.description: Protective marking and references to flags/side flags within the text must be bold.

check.where: Text mentioning security classifications, privacy markings, and flag references.

rules.title: Quotations must be italicised
rules.description: Italics are used for quotations, foreign words and the names of publications.
rules.notes: Ambiguity risk: detection of quotations is heuristic. Plugin should flag quoted spans for confirmation.

rules.title: Left and right margins must be 2 cm
rules.description: Left and right margins of 2 cm are used for all documents.

autofix.description: Set left and right margins to 2 cm.

rules.title: Briefs require a 4 cm right margin
rules.description: Briefs and point briefs use a 4.0 cm right margin to leave room for manuscript notes.

rules.title: Top and bottom margins must be 2 cm
rules.description: Top and bottom margins of 2.0 cm are normally used for all documents.

rules.title: Header and footer margins must be 1.5 cm
rules.description: Header and footer margins (protective markings, page numbers etc.) are set at 1.5 cm.

check.where: Header and footer distance from page edge.

rules.title: Paragraph numbers start at the margin, text indented 1 cm
rules.description: Where paragraphs are numbered, the numbers start at the left margin and the first word of the text starts 1.0 cm from the margin. Block indentation of 1.0 cm applies to further subdivisions.

rules.title: Tabs should be set every 1.0 cm
rules.description: Tabs are set every 1.0 cm (or ½ in) for consistent horizontal spacing.

check.where: Default tab stops of the document.

rules.title: Text blocks are single-spaced
rules.description: Blocks of text (paragraphs, headings of two or more lines, lists of references or annexes) are typed single-spaced, with one blank line between blocks.

autofix.description: Set paragraph line spacing to single.

rules.title: At least one blank line between text and page number
rules.description: There should be a minimum of one blank line between the last line of writing and the page number.

check.where: Vertical spacing above the page number in the footer.

rules.title: One space after punctuation
rules.description: One space is left after a comma, colon, semicolon, full stop, question mark and exclamation mark.

autofix.description: Collapse multiple spaces after punctuation to a single space.

rules.title: Underlining must not be used for emphasis
rules.description: Underlining is used only in manuscripts in lieu of bolding, and must not be used to achieve emphasis in typed text.

rules.title: Drafts must carry the word DRAFT
rules.description: Manuscript drafts must be double spaced and the word 'DRAFT' written at the top of the first page below the security grading or privacy marking.

check.where: Top of the first page, below any security grading.

rules.title: Drafts are double-spaced in the text
rules.description: Drafts for a minister, senior officer or official are produced with the text in double spacing or 1½ spacing.
rules.notes: Only applicable to hard-copy drafts; electronic drafts may use normal spacing.

rules.title: Page numbers at bottom centre above the classification
rules.description: All pages other than single-page documents are numbered at the bottom centre, immediately above the security classification and privacy markings.

rules.title: Signature block must not appear alone at the top of a page
rules.description: A signature block must never appear by itself at the top of a page; at least one line of text must be above it.
rules.notes: Word: set 'keep with previous' on the signature block, or check page-break position programmatically.

rules.title: No hanging headings
rules.description: A heading must not be left alone at the bottom of a page with its text on the next page.
